crew.overview: Adventure awaits 12 year old Brendan who must fight Vikings and a serpent god to find a crystal and complete the legendary Book of Kells. In order to finish Brother Aiden's book, Brendan must overcome his deepest fears on a secret quest that will take him beyond the abbey walls and into the enchanted forest where dangerous mythical creatures hide. Will Brendan succeed in his quest?
crew.title: The Secret of Kells

details.biography: Claire Paoletti is a screenwriter and author. After training in cinema and art history at university, Paoletti worked on numerous series, particularly in animation. She then turned to feature films with All at the Top of the World, directed by Rémi Chayé. Claire also participates in short films including Bang, Bang! by Julien Bisaro. At the same time, she published a children's novel Mark Logan and created a collection entitled Fée en herbe. In 2016, she co-founded Picolo Pictures with Julien Bisaro.
details.name: Claire Paoletti
